description: Indicatoren van het Performantiecontract is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. In het performantiecontract van Infrabel, goedgekeurd door de Ministerraad op 23/12/2022, dat betrekking heeft op de periode 2023-2032, is een hoofdstuk gewijd aan het proces van opvolging en continue verbetering van de prestaties van Infrabel. Dit proces is een overeenkomst tussen Infrabel, de minister bevoegd voor Mobiliteit en de FOD Mobiliteit en Vervoer. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Veiligheid, Infrastructuur, Financiën. Its keywords are Performantie, Overheid, Infrabel. The portal shows 2025-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
